events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. What's the one song from the album that still resonates most with you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, better known as Sting, the legendary musician and frontman of The Police, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's musical journey
angles.copy: From The Police to a stellar solo career, Sting is 75 today. What's your favourite track from his incredible catalogue?

events.title: Original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple revolutionised portable music 25 years ago today with the release of the first iPod.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. Did you have one of the first models?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Which iconic 007 film or theme tune is your absolute favourite? Licence to thrill us with your choices!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring legacy
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your most cherished Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's comedic genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career, from Python to Fawlty Towers?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album memories
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. Which track from this sprawling masterpiece is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost an icon. Remembering the extraordinary Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's enduring voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we said goodbye to Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's lasting impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Share your thoughts on his incredible legacy.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's timeless artistry
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate what would have been David Bowie's 80th birthday. A true innovator, his influence is still felt everywhere. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's enduring reign
angles.copy: The King, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His impact on music is immeasurable. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page's guitar mastery
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your all-time favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's timeless hits
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to solo superstardom, what's the Rod hit that always gets you singing along?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness frontman's birthday
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... it's Suggs' 66th birthday! What's your favourite Madness anthem?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for his distinctive soulful voice and hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's soulful sound
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined an era. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?
